scope.purpose: Source evidence for donor global label wording and review dispositions.
scope.lexicalSenses: Character selectors are meaning fields for the cited Japanese character. They establish the selected lexical sense.
scope.radicalNames: Radical names and form labels draw on the specific form entry or the cited Kanji Alive radical row. Column indicators select a term in the Meaning field. CSV row numbering starts at 1 and includes the header.
scope.visualCues: Reviewed cues are authored mnemonic labels. A link reuses or relates a cue within its approved mnemonic scope.
scope.publication: Coverage evidence only. Occurrence-level semantic, phonetic, etymological and historical claims require their own evidence and review.
scope.sourceText: Exact lexical senses are identified by selector. Any supported wording is the reviewer’s proposed English rendering.
